## Overview

Samsung's 26 cu ft Mega Capacity Counter Depth, 3-Door French Door refrigerator has a modern design to blend seamlessly into your kitchen; Get extra space to store more groceries, including big and bulky items; Plus, get easy access to chilled water and curved or crushed ice from the external dispenser and Sphere Ice™ from the ice maker in the freezer.

- 26 cu ft Mega Capacity: Store more groceries, with extra room to stay organized; Our 26 cu ft mega capacity refrigerator gives you more space and easy access to what you need.

- Sphere Ice™: Enhance your drinks with Sphere Ice™ - its slow-melting, rounded shape keeps drinks colder, longer; (compared to cubed ice)

- External Water & Ice Dispenser: Get easy access to chilled, filtered water and curved ice, with the external dispenser.

- Three types of ice: Get easy access to chilled water and curved or crushed ice from the external dispenser and Sphere Ice™ from the ice maker in the freezer.

- Slide-in Shelf: The adjustable slide-in shelf is flexibly designed to fit in just half of the fridge, so you can slide it back to create more room for tall and bulky items.

- All-Around Cooling: Continuously monitors temperature, to ensure consistent cooling from corner to corner; It also keeps the internal temperature the same throughout the fridge, so groceries stay fresher, longer.

- LED Lighting: LED lighting beautifully illuminates the interior of your fridge so you can quickly spot what you want.

- ADA Compliant: Easy-to-reach controls for everyone.

- 10 Year Warranty: Get a 10 year warranty on parts and 5 years of coverage for labor, on the Digital Inverter™ Compressor.
